# Comparison C read as widening

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

On the frame of a web's level paths (Web.paths), claims are pairs of a formation and a step, and a level path realizes one exactly when it admits the formation at that step. With every claim counting as living, an extension of l′ by l (Extension: realizing every claim l′ realizes, and one more) is exactly l widening l′, including and exceeding it (Web.paths_extension_iff_widens). For any reading of living, an extension is an extension with every claim living, so with “better” read as widening, C, that every extension is better, holds (Web.paths_comparison_widens), with no axiom. Under the continuation condition, widening is retaining and adding what has significance (Web.widens_iff_retains_adds, see significance-retained-within-margin), so the C the continuation condition gives on level paths (Web.paths_g0_comparison, see one-axiom-yields-g0) is its reading in significance.

Canonical source: [Significance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The frame of level paths (Web.paths): claims are pairs of a formation and a step, and a level path realizes one exactly when it admits the formation at that step; the comparison is between any two level paths.
- “Better” is read as widening what can form (Web.Widens); C is a theorem on this reading, and remains a premise where “better” is read otherwise or on a general frame.
- Discrete steps; natural-number levels and needs.

Ren asked on 11 October 2026: “can we reduce is "for anything, its continuation into the future leads to more futures(flourishes/plurality) from generatively" - so we can be like "these are space where generatively happens", which allows us to derive everything without axiom?”, and decided: “as long as the derivation of the rules doesn't rely on axiom, don't use one”. The AI's reading: widening reads “leads to more futures”, Ren having confirmed that possibilities are what can form next; the generative space is where a part widens what can form. On Ren's delegation “flourishes/plurality” is read by widening, plurality an aspect not yet measured, and widening is the space of 生生 (D22).

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 37 theorems of Becoming.Significance, the 26 of Becoming.Regions and the 35 of Becoming.Metaethics all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §78 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

C holds here by definition on the frame of level paths, with “better” read as widening; on a general frame, or with “better” read otherwise, C remains a premise. Widening is a partial order: mixed parts are not ordered, and ordering them needs a measure. The normative warrant for calling widening “better” is open (chapter section 8): after the reduction, the axiom's step of invariance becomes the content of calling the generative space good. Reading widening as Ren's “more futures” and as 生生 is the AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation. No ethical predicate occurs.

- Widening does not order every pair of level paths: the conveyor's part leaves the two paths mixed (Transfer.mixed, see four-cases-of-a-part). [Admission.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Admission.lean)
